name: terminal-manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,json,hashlib,base64,datetime,re
p=pathlib.Path.cwd();expected='72652b9dafe3bd02118ce883954ccc846e2c937e34edd8d39a7aee50603a624a'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert sha((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes())==expected
assert (p/'reservation.sha256').read_text().split()[0]==expected
r=json.loads((p/'raw-provenance.json').read_text())['records'];res=json.loads((p/'keyedresults.json').read_text());ids=json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids']
assert len(r)==len(res)==len(ids)==20 and set(r)==set(res)==set(map(str,ids))
chunks={};verified=[]
root=p.parents[1]/'lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus'
for i,x in r.items():
 f=pathlib.Path(x['chunk_path']);assert f.parent==root and re.fullmatch(r'mathdb-normalized-chunk-\d+\.jsonl',f.name)
 if str(f) not in chunks:chunks[str(f)]=f.read_bytes()
 b=chunks[str(f)];assert sha(b)==x['chunk_sha256'];raw=base64.b64decode(x['raw_base64']);assert raw==x['raw_utf8'].encode() and raw.endswith(b'\n')
 assert raw==b.splitlines(keepends=True)[x['line_1based']-1] and sha(raw)==x['raw_sha256'];ob=json.loads(raw);assert ob==x['object'];assert sha(ob['statement'].encode())==x['statement_utf8_sha256'];assert res[i]['literal_statement']==ob['statement'] and res[i]['accepted_credit']==0;verified.append(i)
plans=[json.loads((p/('search-plan-batch'+str(n)+'.json')).read_text()) for n in [1,2,3]]
assert sum(len(z['queries']) for z in plans)==9
budget=json.loads((p/'search-budget.json').read_text());assert budget['used_batches']==3 and budget['used_queries']==9
excluded={'sha256-manifest.json':'self-reference','terminal-verification.json':'written after manifest; records verification and manifest hash','terminal-manifest.receipt.json':'runner emits after this child exits; cannot hash prospective bytes','terminal-manifest.output.txt':'runner emits after this child exits; cannot hash prospective bytes'}
files={}
for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 if f.is_file() and f.relative_to(p).as_posix() not in excluded:
  assert not f.is_symlink();files[f.relative_to(p).as_posix()]={'sha256':sha(f.read_bytes()),'bytes':f.stat().st_size}
manifest={'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'algorithm':'SHA256','files':files,'terminal_exclusions':excluded,'scope':'only own lane; no protected/external bodies included'}
(p/'sha256-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
for n,v in files.items():assert sha((p/n).read_bytes())==v['sha256']
receipts=[n for n in files if n.endswith('.receipt.json') or n=='bootstrap-receipt.json']
assert 'first-extraction.receipt.json' in receipts and 'preserve-records.receipt.json' in receipts and 'bootstrap-receipt.json' in receipts
assert json.loads((p/'preserve-records.receipt.json').read_text())['exit']==1
# All handback artifacts are now written. Post-handback reservation check, with no reservation mutation.
assert sha((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes())==expected
verification={'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'manifest_sha256':sha((p/'sha256-manifest.json').read_bytes()),'verified_files':len(files),'completed_receipt_JSONs_included':receipts,'verified_original_records':verified,'original_chunk_hashes_verified':{k:sha(v) for k,v in chunks.items()},'reservation_before_extraction':'first-extraction.receipt.json exit0 verifies exact reservation before corpus extraction','reservation_after_handback':expected,'original_newlines_and_full_objects':True,'all_included_manifest_hashes_match':True,'terminal_exclusions':excluded,'credit':0,'campaign_accepted':52,'campaign_target':60,'jobs':'all provided-runner child and converter work joined/reaped; terminal runner will reap this payload; no background workers'}
(p/'terminal-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(verification,indent=2))
print(json.dumps({'verified_files':len(files),'completed_receipt_JSONs':len(receipts),'original_records':len(verified),'reservation':expected,'manifest_sha256':verification['manifest_sha256'],'credit':0,'accepted':'52/60'}))
